messages:
olivia_acct_mgr: FYI BrightPath flagged their Aug private invoice — platform fee true-up line much higher than expected after they moved a subset of nodes to a different SKU. Procurement put payment on hold.
billing-bot: Invoice #BP-2026-08 generated 2026-08-02 08:07 UTC. platform_fee_total: $47,150; support_tier: enterprise; meter: bp-cluster-7.
derek_billing: Filing FIN-5488. Olivia, do we have the change order or migration window? Could be a meter tag mismatch causing both SKUs to bill.
olivia_acct_mgr: Customer says they migrated 10 nodes from sku-gpu-a -> sku-gpu-b on 2026-08-10 02:10 UTC. They expected prorated new SKU charges only; invoice shows charges for both SKUs for the full month.
leo_engops: pulling billing_events for bp-cluster-7: `SELECT id, ts, sku, amount, note FROM billing_events WHERE resource='bp-cluster-7' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' ORDER BY ts;`
leo_engops: results: bf-14011 monthly_sku_a $24,000 (2026-08-01), bf-14012 sku_migration_prorate sku_b $12,400 (2026-08-10), bf-14013 monthly_sku_b $12,750 (2026-08-01). Looks like monthly_sku_b applied even though migration occurred mid-month.
marta_finance: That explains the ~40% bump. Finance can approve a provisional credit up to $13k while ops investigates. GL: CU-CR-SKU.
derek_billing: I'll mark invoice BP-2026-08 disputed and create provisional credit memo CM-BP-2026-08-P for $12,750 pending root-cause. Approve @marta_finance?
marta_finance: Approved provisional_credit_amount: "$12,750". Finance will review final backfill results before posting to ledger.
leo_engops: Root cause: SKU migration job sets node tags but the monthly rollup used cached inventory snapshot taken at 00:00 UTC; when migration happened later, the rollup still billed sku_b monthly because the inventory snapshot included the new SKU due to out-of-order inventory writes. Fix: make rollup read authoritative inventory at rollup time and add version guard. PR #4991 opened.
leo_engops: Scheduling cleanup backfill (backfill-bp-222) to remove bf-14013 if it overlaps prorate window. ETA ~6 hrs.
olivia_acct_mgr: Draft customer message: "We've placed a provisional credit of $12,750 against the disputed platform fee and paused collection while we correct a billing overlap from your Aug 10 migration. We'll confirm final numbers within 72 hours and attach the credit memo to the invoice." Approve?
derek_billing: approve, include FIN-5488 and CM reference once created.
leo_engops: backfill completed 1 removed duplicate bf-14013. delta = -$12,750. ENG-BILL-256 resolved.
derek_billing: Issuing credit memo CM-BP-2026-08-1 for $12,750 and attaching to BP-2026-08. Invoice status set to adjusted.
marta_finance: Finance to post GL CU-CR-SKU $12,750 once CM clears. We'll sign off on ledger entry then close FIN-5488.
olivia_acct_mgr: Customer responded: "Thanks, procurement cleared the hold. Good to go on the renewal." Closing loop on account side.
derek_billing: Postmortem items: add unit test for inventory/rollup ordering, nightly audit for same-resource multiple platform_fee events, update billing runbook for migration windows. Owners: leo_engops (eng), marta_finance (finance).
marta_finance: FIN-5488 -> resolved. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
